headline: Panthers’ Jacob Markstrom to miss 10-14 days; Cooper Black recalled
take:
Per Daily Faceoff, Florida goalie Jacob Markstrom will miss 10 to 14 days after getting hurt in practice on Tuesday. The Panthers have recalled Cooper Black from AHL Charlotte.

The timing stings a little, because Markstrom has been better than his save percentage suggests. His .897 looks ordinary, but he has saved 1.28 goals more than expected so far this season (goals saved above expected measures how many goals a goalie prevented compared with an average goalie facing the same shots). Last year he was at minus 15.98 over 44 games, so this is a rebound, though six games is a small sample. FLA overall sits at 5-2-2 with 53.5% of the expected goals (the quality of chances, which is a better read on play than the score), and the team has scored 1.5 fewer goals than its chances warranted. The Panthers' goaltending as a group is 2.3 goals above expected, so the net has not been the problem. Their 56% expected goal share at five-on-five is the stronger signal. For fantasy owners, Markstrom is a hold only if the roster can absorb two weeks. The Panthers' underlying numbers say the team should stay steady, but whoever fills in has little room to slip.
